title: M3-PG
description: An architect's monochrome: white paper, near-black ink and one mid grey for secondary numbers and the quiet half of headlines. Inter throughout, uppercase semibold headlines set solid with tight tracking; square corners, 1px grey hairlines, no shadows, a 4-column desktop grid with 20px gutters.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in charcoal with light-grey ink
there is no accent colour: primary is the ink itself, muted-foreground is the big grey
the gutter is 10px on phones and 20px from 768px; page width 1440px
